name: IntentFence Policy Agent
description: Preflights a proposed agent payment against declared spend, scope, data-retention, and human-approval constraints.

skills.name: Agent payment preflight
skills.description: Evaluate caller-declared payment intent and return safe_to_proceed, needs_review, or denied before the caller invokes its downstream tool. IntentFence does not independently authorize or execute the action.
examples: Check whether a declared 428.20 USD quote is within a declared 500 USD ceiling.
